newsitem.title: USA: N. Korea to respond next week on peace proposal.
newsitem.headline: N. Korea to respond next week on peace proposal.

text.p: North Korea has promised to give its response next week to a U.S.-South Korea proposal for peace talks, the State Department said on Thursday.
Spokesman Nicholas Burns said delegations from all three countries would meet in New York on April 16 and the United States hoped the North Korean response would be positive.

The United States and South Korea proposed the four-party talks last year as a way to defuse tensions on the Korean peninsula and get to a peace treaty that would finally close the books on the 1950-53 war that divided the peninsula.
China would also take part in the negotiations.

Pyongyang's decision to give a formal response to the proposal came at a time of heightened international concern about food shortages in the isolated, Stalinist-ruled country and of increased willingness by the United States and other countries to provide humanitarian assistance.
